<!--
  Macros converted from Francisco's TeXstudio preamble.
  Rules for this file:
  - No % comments: in Markdown they show up as visible text. Use HTML comments like this one.
  - \DeclareMathOperator is converted to \operatorname here (see the notes in the chat).
-->

<!-- Bolds -->
\newcommand{\E}{\exists~\!}
\newcommand{\C}{\mathbb{C}}
\newcommand{\R}{\mathbb{R}}
\newcommand{\Q}{\mathbb{Q}}
\newcommand{\Z}{\mathbb{Z}}
\newcommand{\N}{\mathbb{N}}
\newcommand{\A}{\mathbb{A}}
\newcommand{\F}{\mathbb{F}}
\newcommand{\G}{\mathbb{G}}
\renewcommand{\P}{\mathbb{P}}

<!-- Commutative algebra and group theory -->
\newcommand{\p}{\mathfrak{p}}
\renewcommand{\q}{\mathfrak{q}}
\renewcommand{\a}{\mathfrak{a}}
\newcommand{\m}{\mathfrak{m}}
\newcommand{\lth}[1]{\text{length}_{#1}}
\newcommand{\sgn}{\operatorname{sgn}}
\newcommand{\gal}{\operatorname{Gal}}
\newcommand{\rad}{\operatorname{rad}}
\newcommand{\nil}{\operatorname{Nil}}
\newcommand{\zz}[1]{\mathbb{Z}/#1\mathbb{Z}}
\newcommand{\tr}{\operatorname{tr}}
\newcommand{\inv}{\operatorname{inv}}
\newcommand{\car}{\operatorname{char}}
\newcommand{\ann}{\operatorname{Ann}}
\newcommand{\rk}{\operatorname{rk}}
\newcommand{\ff}{\operatorname{Frac}}
\newcommand{\Der}{\operatorname{Der}}
\newcommand{\heit}{\operatorname{ht}}
\newcommand{\trdeg}{\operatorname{trdeg}}
\newcommand{\ps}[1]{[\![ #1 ]\!]}

<!-- Homological algebra and categories -->
\newcommand{\id}{\text{id}}
\renewcommand{\hom}{\text{Hom}}
\newcommand{\nd}{\text{End}}
\newcommand{\aut}{\operatorname{Aut}}
\renewcommand{\c}[1]{\mathcal{#1}}
\newcommand{\cat}[1]{\textsf{#1}}
\newcommand{\Mod}[1]{\text{Mod}_{#1}}
\renewcommand{\k}[1]{#1^{\bullet}}
\newcommand{\im}{\operatorname{im}}
\newcommand{\coker}{\operatorname{coker}}
\newcommand{\nat}{\operatorname{Nat}}
\newcommand{\pr}{\operatorname{pr}}
\newcommand{\kom}{\operatorname{Kom}}
\newcommand{\obj}{\operatorname{Obj}}
\newcommand{\mor}{\operatorname{Mor}}
\newcommand{\ext}{\operatorname{Ext}}
\newcommand{\tor}{\operatorname{Tor}}
\newcommand{\colim}{\operatorname{colim}}
\newcommand{\Eq}{\operatorname{Eq}}

<!-- Exact sequences -->
\newcommand{\ex}[5]{0\longrightarrow #1\overset{#4}{\longrightarrow} #2\overset{#5}{\longrightarrow} #3\longrightarrow 0}
\newcommand{\ftex}[5]{0\rightarrow #1\rightarrow #2\rightarrow #3\rightarrow #4\rightarrow #5}
\newcommand{\lex}[5]{0\longrightarrow #1\overset{#4}{\longrightarrow}  #2\overset{#5}{\longrightarrow} #3}
\newcommand{\rex}[5]{ #1\overset{#4}{\longrightarrow} #2\overset{#5}{\longrightarrow} #3\longrightarrow 0}
\newcommand{\exl}[5]{\cdots\longrightarrow #1\overset{#4}{\longrightarrow} #2\overset{#5}{\longrightarrow} #3\longrightarrow \cdots}
\newcommand{\lrex}[5]{ #1\overset{#4}{\longrightarrow} #2\overset{#5}{\longrightarrow} #3}
\newcommand{\resol}[5]{0\longrightarrow #1\overset{#4}{\longrightarrow} #2\overset{#5}{\longrightarrow} #3\longrightarrow \cdots}

<!-- Scheme theory -->
\newcommand{\ox}[1]{\mathcal{O}_{#1}}
\newcommand{\sh}[1]{\mathscr{#1}}
\newcommand{\spec}{\operatorname{Spec}}
\newcommand{\Proj}{\operatorname{Proj}}
\newcommand{\codim}{\operatorname{codim}}
\newcommand{\an}[1]{#1^{\text{an}}}
\newcommand{\Pic}{\operatorname{Pic}}
\newcommand{\Cl}{\operatorname{Cl}}
\newcommand{\Div}{\operatorname{Div}}
\newcommand{\PDiv}{\operatorname{PDiv}}
\newcommand{\Coh}{\operatorname{Coh}}
\newcommand{\Supp}{\operatorname{Supp}}
\newcommand{\divi}{\operatorname{div}}
\newcommand{\ord}{\operatorname{ord}}
\newcommand{\Br}{\operatorname{Br}}
\newcommand{\Const}{\operatorname{Const}}
\newcommand{\Hom}{\operatorname{\mathscr{H}\!\mathit{om}}}
\newcommand{\Qcoh}{\operatorname{Qcoh}}

<!-- Cohomology on sites -->
\newcommand{\fppf}[3]{H^{#3}_{\text{fppf}}(#1,#2)}
\newcommand{\et}[3]{H^{#3}_{\text{ét}}(#1,#2)}
\newcommand{\zar}[3]{H^{#3}_{\text{Zar}}(#1,#2)}
\newcommand{\cech}[2]{\check{H}^{#2}(\mathcal{U},#1)}
\newcommand{\Sch}[1]{(\text{Sch}/#1)^{\text{op}}}
\newcommand{\fsh}[1]{\widetilde{#1}_{\text{pl}}}
\renewcommand{\H}{\mathscr{H}}

<!-- Others -->
\newcommand{\ds}{\displaystyle}
\newcommand{\pp}[1]{\left(#1\right)}
\newcommand{\Tau}{\large\tau}
\newcommand{\np}[2]{\langle #1|#2\rangle}
\newcommand{\fl}[1]{\left\lfloor #1\right\rfloor}
\newcommand{\cyc}[1]{\langle #1 \rangle}
\newcommand{\ev}{\operatorname{ev}}

<!-- Geometry -->
\newcommand{\Top}{\operatorname{Man}}
\newcommand{\Sm}{\operatorname{Sm}_{\mathbb{R}}}
\newcommand{\Com}{\operatorname{Sm}_{\mathbb{C}}}

<!-- Number theory -->
\newcommand{\ft}[1]{#1^{(p)}}

<!-- Kept from the original site macros (no clash with the above) -->
\newcommand{\Spec}{\operatorname{Spec}}
\newcommand{\uHom}{\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}}
\newcommand{\Ext}{\operatorname{Ext}}
\newcommand{\Gal}{\operatorname{Gal}}
\newcommand{\cO}{\mathcal{O}}
\newcommand{\cF}{\mathcal{F}}
\newcommand{\bZ}{\mathbb{Z}}
\newcommand{\bQ}{\mathbb{Q}}
\newcommand{\bF}{\mathbb{F}}
\newcommand{\Ga}{\mathbb{G}_{\mathrm{a}}}
\newcommand{\Gm}{\mathbb{G}_{\mathrm{m}}}
